newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - March 31.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - March 31.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Arab states take a decision to freeze normalisation of ties with Israel.
- Gunman opens fire on children in two schools in Yemen, killing eight and injuring 11 others.

- Saudi Defence Minister Prince Sultan orders the formation of a committee to settle a problem between Riyad Bank and Saudi Arabian Airlines over the payment of 300 million riyal interest on a three billion riyal loan.
- Palestinian President Arafat says Israel has announced a political, military and economic war against Palestinians, calls for global unity to achieve peace.
- Saudi's Riyad Bank posts 809 million riyal net profit in 1996.
- Saudi Interior Minister Prince Nayef discloses a Saudi comprehensive training plan to employ Saudi nationals.
